items.description: The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit will take place from Nov 2 to 5 in Wuzhen, East China's Zhejiang province. The summit will gather executives from leading technology companies and developers of open-source large models to discuss how to build a global open-source AI ecosystem. Watch the video to find out!
